description: This file defines the TimestampShape class, which extends the Shape class, representing a timestamp data type used in AWS API serialization/deserialization. It includes methods for formatting timestamp values in different formats.

classes.name: TimestampShape
classes.description: Represents a timestamp shape used in AWS API for serializing and formatting timestamp data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TimestampShape instance, setting the type to 'timestamp'.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into the specified format ('iso8601', 'rfc822', or 'unixTimestamp') for service communication.
